paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go pricing per 1 million input/output tokens, varying by model and deployment type; provisioned throughput is priced separately through PTUs and reservations.
resolution_notes: pricing.paid_plans: auditor correct. Official Azure OpenAI pricing (https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/azure-openai/) labels all model rates as Pricing (1M Tokens) for input/output (and cached input), not per 1K; page also documents Standard pay-as-you-go, Provisioned PTUs with reservations, and Batch. Original “per 1K tokens” is outdated.
